newsitem.title: USA: U.S.Office Products files 10 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: U.S.Office Products files 10 mln shr offer.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Thursday to offer up to 10 million common shares.
Of the total, the company said it will offer 6.0 million shares while certain shareholders may sell up to 4.0 million.
The company said it expects net proceeds from its offering of $200.6-$230.2 million, assuming the shares are sold at $35 each and if underwriters exercise their over-allotment option in full.

The company, based here, said it intends to use its proceeds to repay debt under a credit facility and for general corporate purposes. As of January 7, the balance outstanding under the credit facility was $314 million, it said.
The offering will be made through Robertson, Stephens & Co, Morgan Stanley & Co and Smith Barney Inc. The underwriters have an over-allotment option on up to 1.5 million additional shares.
